name: Jobber
summary: Field service software with four plans and quotes on every plan.
differentiator: The cheapest published field-service entry point we read ($29 a month on annual billing for one user), though its quote tools are general: line items, optional extras and signatures, with no electrical database.
pricing: Core $29 a month on annual billing, Connect $99, Grow $149, Plus $399 (15 users). Extra users $29 a month. Month-to-month costs more.

scope.takeoff: None described on the pages we read.
scope.library: Quotes with line items, optional upsell lines and signatures. No electrical database is described.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Line items you set up. No price feed is named on the pricing page.

bestFor: Solo and small-crew electricians doing service work who want a low entry price.
skipIf: You need an electrical database, assemblies or takeoff.
watchOut: Prices vary by team size and billing choice. Check the plan you would actually buy.
